7.7.7.4 Configuration of Event related data
This section describes the configuration of event related data and the access of event related data from the SW-Cs/BSW modules. Note: The configuration model follows a flexible configuration process, but does not imply any explicit implementation. The event related data of diagnostic events contain none or one set of extended data records (refer to DemExtendedDataClass), and none or one set of freeze frame records (refer to DemFreezeFrameClass) with its calculated or configured record numbers. Therefore a class-concept is used (refer to Figure 37). An extended data record, a DID, or a PID can contain one ore more data elements (refer to DemDataElementClass). Note: Asynchronous DIDs, as well as DIDs with a variable length are not supported by the Dem module, and shall therefore not be connected to the Dem.
